title: Cucumber Raita
summary: Rinse, peel and chop or grate a cucumber, whisk chilled curd smooth in a mixing bowl, add the cucumber plus salt, red chilli powder, cumin powder, chaat masala and chopped cilantro, then stir everything together.
source: CaptainCook4D recipe text + task graph (Cucumber Raita); mistake hints from train split

nodes.name: Add red chilli powder
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure a quarter teaspoon of red chilli powder with a measuring spoon and tip it into the bowl of curd.
substeps: Pick up the 1/4 teaspoon measuring spoon.
Fill it level with red chilli powder.
Tip it into the bowl over the curd.
nodes.end_state: A small pinch of bright red powder is visible on top of the curd in the bowl.
nodes.view_hint: the measuring spoon and then down into the bowl

checks.question: Is the red chilli powder being measured in a 1/4 teaspoon spoon?
Is a small amount of red powder now visible on the curd?

mistakes.description: Added an approximate amount without measuring.
mistakes.visual_cue: Chilli powder shaken or pinched directly from the container into the bowl with no measuring spoon.
mistakes.correction: Use the quarter-teaspoon measure for the chilli powder so the raita isn't too hot.
mistakes.early_cue: Chilli container is tilted over the bowl with no spoon in hand.

mistakes.description: Added chilli powder before the curd was whisked.
mistakes.visual_cue: Red powder landing on lumpy curd or in an empty bowl.
mistakes.correction: Whisk the curd smooth first, then add the chilli powder.
mistakes.early_cue: Chilli container opened while curd is still lumpy.

nodes.name: Peel the cucumber
nodes.instruction_novice: Using a vegetable peeler, run it down the length of the cucumber in long strokes, turning it until all the green skin is gone.
substeps: Hold the cucumber firmly at one end on the board.
Pull the peeler from top to bottom in a long stroke.
Rotate the cucumber a little and repeat.
Check for any leftover green strips and peel them off.
nodes.end_state: A pale green, fully skinned cucumber sits on the board with a pile of green peel strips beside it.
nodes.view_hint: the cutting board with the cucumber and the peeler

checks.question: Is a vegetable peeler being used on the cucumber?
Is the cucumber pale all over with no green skin patches remaining?

mistakes.description: Peeling with the wrong tool such as a fork, knife or grater instead of a peeler.
mistakes.visual_cue: A fork, knife or box grater is scraping the cucumber surface; ragged or shredded skin instead of clean strips.
mistakes.correction: Swap that for the vegetable peeler. It takes the skin off cleanly without wasting the cucumber.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up a fork, knife or grater while the cucumber is still unpeeled.

mistakes.description: Peeling incompletely, leaving strips or patches of green skin.
mistakes.visual_cue: Green stripes or patches are still visible on the cucumber when it is set down.
mistakes.correction: There are still some green strips on there. Turn the cucumber and peel off the rest of the skin.
mistakes.early_cue: Peeler strokes only cover one side of the cucumber and it is not being rotated.

mistakes.description: Peeling a zucchini instead of a cucumber.
mistakes.visual_cue: The vegetable being peeled is dark green and smooth with pale, firm flesh; stem end is ribbed.
mistakes.correction: That's a zucchini. Set it aside and peel the cucumber instead.
mistakes.early_cue: Dark green smooth zucchini placed on the cutting board.

nodes.name: Whisk the curd
nodes.instruction_novice: Put 1 cup of chilled curd into a mixing bowl and whisk it with a whisk or spoon in circular strokes until it is smooth and lump-free.
substeps: Get a wide mixing bowl, not a cup or mug.
Measure 1 full cup of chilled curd into the bowl.
Whisk in circles, scraping the sides.
Stop when the curd looks smooth and glossy with no lumps.
nodes.end_state: A mixing bowl holds a smooth, glossy layer of curd with no visible lumps.
nodes.view_hint: straight down into the mixing bowl

checks.question: Is the curd in a wide mixing bowl rather than a cup or mug?
Was a full 1-cup measure of curd added?
Is the curd smooth and lump-free after whisking?
checks.roi: the surface of the curd in the bowl

mistakes.description: Used a coffee mug or other small container instead of a mixing bowl.
mistakes.visual_cue: Curd being spooned into a mug with a handle or a small narrow cup.
mistakes.correction: A mug is too small for this. Move the curd into a proper mixing bowl so there is room to whisk and add the cucumber.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks a coffee mug off the shelf.

mistakes.description: Added less than 1 cup of curd, such as half a cup, or did not measure.
mistakes.visual_cue: Measuring cup only partly filled, or curd spooned straight from the container without a measuring cup.
mistakes.correction: That's less than a cup. Top it up so you have a full level cup of curd.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon goes directly from the curd tub to the bowl with no measuring cup in view.

mistakes.description: Did not whisk, or just pushed the curd up and down instead of stirring in circles.
mistakes.visual_cue: Curd sits lumpy in the bowl; hand pokes or presses it vertically with no circular motion.
mistakes.correction: Move the whisk round and round in circles, scraping the sides, until the curd is completely smooth.
mistakes.early_cue: Curd is added and the hand reaches for the next ingredient without a whisk.

mistakes.description: Whisked the curd in a separate bowl from the one spices were added to, or whisked after the other ingredients were already in.
mistakes.visual_cue: Two bowls in use, or spice powder and cucumber already sitting in the bowl before whisking starts.
mistakes.correction: Whisk the plain curd smooth first, in the one mixing bowl, before anything else goes in.
mistakes.early_cue: A second bowl is pulled out, or a spice container is opened before the curd is whisked.

nodes.name: Add salt
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure a quarter teaspoon of salt with the measuring spoon and add it to the bowl.
substeps: Pick up the 1/4 teaspoon measuring spoon.
Fill it level with salt.
Tip it into the bowl.
nodes.end_state: A small pinch of white salt crystals is sitting on top of the curd in the bowl.
nodes.view_hint: the measuring spoon and then down into the bowl

checks.question: Is the salt being measured with the 1/4 teaspoon spoon, not a larger one?
Has salt been added to the bowl?

mistakes.description: Added 1/2 teaspoon of salt instead of 1/4 teaspoon.
mistakes.visual_cue: The larger 1/2 teaspoon spoon is filled, or the 1/4 spoon is filled twice.
mistakes.correction: That's the half-teaspoon. Use the quarter-teaspoon spoon for the salt, just one level scoop.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up the 1/2 tsp spoon from the set.

mistakes.description: Added salt before whisking the curd.
mistakes.visual_cue: Salt landing on lumpy curd or an empty bowl.
mistakes.correction: Whisk the curd smooth first, then add the salt.
mistakes.early_cue: Salt container opened while curd is still unwhisked.

nodes.name: Chop or grate the cucumber
nodes.instruction_novice: On the cutting board, chop the peeled cucumber into small even pieces with a sharp knife, or grate it on a grater.
substeps: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise, then into strips.
Line up the strips and cut across into small cubes.
Or rub the cucumber down a grater over the board.
Gather the pieces into a pile on the board.
nodes.end_state: A pile of small, roughly even cucumber pieces or shreds sits on the cutting board.
nodes.view_hint: the cutting board under the hands

checks.question: Is a knife or grater being used, not scissors?
Is the cucumber cut into small, fairly even pieces or shreds with no large chunks left?
checks.roi: the pile of cucumber on the board

mistakes.description: Cucumber not chopped properly, leaving big uneven chunks or whole slices.
mistakes.visual_cue: Large thick rounds or irregular chunks on the board instead of small dice or shreds.
mistakes.correction: Those pieces are too big. Cut them down into small, even cubes so they mix into the curd.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife makes only a few wide-spaced cuts along the cucumber.

mistakes.description: Cutting with scissors or a blunt knife with an improper chopping action.
mistakes.visual_cue: Scissors snipping the cucumber, or a knife pressing and crushing the cucumber rather than slicing cleanly.
mistakes.correction: Use a sharp kitchen knife on the board and slice with a rocking motion instead of pressing or snipping.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up scissors or a small blunt table knife.

mistakes.description: Chopping a zucchini instead of a cucumber.
mistakes.visual_cue: Pieces are firm and pale cream with a dark green rim, not watery light green cucumber with visible seeds.
mistakes.correction: That's zucchini you're chopping. Switch to the peeled cucumber.
mistakes.early_cue: A dark green zucchini is on the board instead of the peeled cucumber.

nodes.name: Combine all the ingredients
nodes.instruction_novice: Take a spoon and stir everything in the bowl thoroughly, scraping the sides, until the spices and cucumber are evenly spread through the curd.
nodes.instruction_expert: Stir everything with spoon until even
substeps: Pick up a spoon.
Stir from the bottom up and around the sides.
Keep going until no streaks of powder or dry spice remain.
Check the cucumber is spread evenly through the curd.
parts: mixing bowl with curd, cucumber, spices and cilantro
nodes.end_state: The raita is a uniform pale, lightly speckled mixture with cucumber and cilantro spread evenly and no dry powder visible.
nodes.view_hint: straight down into the mixing bowl

checks.question: Is a spoon being used to stir the mixture?
Does the mixture look uniform with no separate patches of powder or cucumber on top?

mistakes.description: Just rotated or swirled the bowl without actually stirring.
mistakes.visual_cue: Bowl turned in circles on the counter; spices still sit in distinct heaps on top of the curd.
mistakes.correction: Spinning the bowl won't mix it. Use the spoon and stir right through the curd.
mistakes.early_cue: Both hands grip the bowl rim and start turning it.

mistakes.description: Used a knife instead of a spoon to combine.
mistakes.visual_cue: A knife blade dragged through the curd.
mistakes.correction: Put the knife down and grab a spoon to mix properly.
mistakes.early_cue: The chopping knife is lifted toward the bowl.

mistakes.description: Mixed only briefly, leaving streaks of spice and unmixed cucumber.
mistakes.visual_cue: Visible red or brown streaks of powder and cucumber piled on one side after stirring stops.
mistakes.correction: Keep stirring a bit longer until all the spice streaks disappear and everything is evenly mixed.
mistakes.early_cue: Only one or two spoon passes before the spoon is set down.

nodes.name: Add chopped cilantro
nodes.instruction_novice: Pick the cilantro leaves off the stems, chop them finely with a knife, then measure one tablespoon and add it to the bowl.
substeps: Strip the leaves from the cilantro stems.
Chop the leaves finely with a knife on the board.
Fill a tablespoon measure with the chopped leaves.
Tip it into the bowl.
nodes.end_state: Finely chopped green cilantro is scattered on top of the curd in the bowl.
nodes.view_hint: the cutting board, then the tablespoon, then into the bowl

checks.question: Is the cilantro finely chopped with a knife, with stems removed?
checks.roi: the chopped cilantro on the board

checks.question: Was exactly one tablespoon measure of cilantro added?

mistakes.description: Tore the cilantro by hand or used a peeler instead of chopping with a knife, leaving stems in.
mistakes.visual_cue: Fingers ripping leaves into large ragged pieces, or a peeler scraping the herbs; long stems in the pile.
mistakes.correction: Pull the leaves off the stems and chop them finely with a knife on the board instead of tearing.
mistakes.early_cue: Hands tearing the bunch, or a peeler picked up near the cilantro.

mistakes.description: Added an unmeasured or doubled amount, like two tablespoons.
mistakes.visual_cue: Cilantro scooped by hand into the bowl, or the tablespoon filled and emptied twice.
mistakes.correction: Just one level tablespoon of cilantro, measured with the spoon.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand grabs the whole chopped pile without a measuring spoon.

mistakes.description: Added cilantro before the curd was whisked.
mistakes.visual_cue: Green herbs land on lumpy curd or in an empty bowl.
mistakes.correction: Whisk the curd smooth first, then add the cilantro.
mistakes.early_cue: Cilantro chopped and lifted toward the bowl while curd is unwhisked.

nodes.name: Add cumin powder
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure one teaspoon of cumin powder, the brownish ground spice, and add it to the bowl.
substeps: Find the cumin powder container (ground, brownish-khaki powder).
Fill the 1 teaspoon measure level.
Tip it into the bowl.
nodes.end_state: A small heap of khaki-brown powder is visible on the curd in the bowl.
nodes.view_hint: the spice container label and the spoon, then into the bowl

checks.question: Is the spice a khaki-brown ground powder (cumin), not reddish-brown cinnamon or whole seeds?
Is it measured in a 1 teaspoon spoon?

mistakes.description: Added cinnamon powder instead of cumin powder.
mistakes.visual_cue: Powder is a warm reddish-brown and very fine, and the container label reads cinnamon.
mistakes.correction: That's cinnamon. Put it back and use the cumin powder, the khaki-coloured one.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for a cinnamon container on the spice rack.

mistakes.description: Added whole cumin seeds instead of cumin powder.
mistakes.visual_cue: Small oval brown seeds on the spoon rather than a fine powder.
mistakes.correction: Those are whole cumin seeds. The recipe needs cumin powder, so switch to the ground version.
mistakes.early_cue: A jar of whole seeds is picked up.

mistakes.description: Added cumin before whisking the curd.
mistakes.visual_cue: Powder landing on lumpy curd or an empty bowl.
mistakes.correction: Whisk the curd smooth first, then add the cumin.
mistakes.early_cue: Cumin container opened while curd is still unwhisked.

nodes.name: Rinse the cucumber
nodes.instruction_novice: Take one medium cucumber and rinse the whole thing under running water, turning it so every side gets washed.
substeps: Pick up one medium cucumber (not a zucchini).
Hold it under running water.
Turn it so both ends and all sides get rinsed.
Shake off the water and set it on the board.
nodes.end_state: A wet, clean cucumber is lying on the cutting board or counter near the sink.
nodes.view_hint: the sink and the cucumber in the hands

checks.question: Is the item being rinsed a cucumber with light green, slightly bumpy skin rather than a dark green smooth zucchini?
Has the entire cucumber, including both ends, been held under the water?

mistakes.description: Used a zucchini instead of a cucumber.
mistakes.visual_cue: The vegetable is dark green, smooth and glossy with a ribbed stem end, instead of a lighter, bumpy cucumber.
mistakes.correction: That looks like a zucchini, not a cucumber. Put it back and grab the cucumber instead.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches toward a dark green zucchini on the counter or in the fridge.

mistakes.description: Rinsed only one half of the cucumber and skipped the other half.
mistakes.visual_cue: Only one end goes under the tap; the other half stays dry and never gets turned toward the water.
mistakes.correction: Flip the cucumber around and rinse the other half too, so the whole thing is clean.
mistakes.early_cue: The cucumber is held by one end under the water without being rotated.

nodes.name: Add cucumber to the curd
nodes.instruction_novice: Scoop the chopped or grated cucumber off the board with your hand or a spoon and add it into the whisked curd.
substeps: Bring the board next to the bowl.
Scoop the cucumber up with a spoon or cupped hand.
Drop it into the curd.
Scrape any leftover pieces off the board into the bowl.
nodes.end_state: The cucumber pieces are sitting on top of the smooth curd in the bowl, with the board nearly clean.
nodes.view_hint: down into the mixing bowl and the board beside it

checks.question: Are the cucumber pieces now inside the bowl on top of the whisked curd?
Is the counter around the bowl free of spilled cucumber pieces?

mistakes.description: Tipped the entire cutting board over the bowl, spilling cucumber onto the counter.
mistakes.visual_cue: Whole board lifted and tilted over the bowl; cucumber pieces scattered on the kitchen platform.
mistakes.correction: Use a spoon or your hand to move the cucumber instead of tipping the whole board, then pick up the spilled bits.
mistakes.early_cue: Both hands lift the cutting board off the counter.

mistakes.description: Adding cucumber before the curd has been whisked.
mistakes.visual_cue: Cucumber lands on lumpy, unwhisked curd or an empty bowl.
mistakes.correction: Hold on, whisk the curd smooth first, then add the cucumber.
mistakes.early_cue: Curd in bowl still looks lumpy when the board is brought over.

nodes.name: Add chaat masala
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure half a teaspoon of chaat masala and tip it carefully into the bowl without spilling.
substeps: Pick up the 1/2 teaspoon measuring spoon.
Fill it level from the chaat masala packet or jar, over the counter.
Carry it over the bowl and tip it in gently.
nodes.end_state: A pinch of greyish-brown chaat masala sits on the curd with no powder spilled on the counter.
nodes.view_hint: the measuring spoon and the counter around the bowl

checks.question: Is the chaat masala measured in the 1/2 teaspoon spoon rather than a full teaspoon?
Is the counter around the bowl free of spilled powder?

mistakes.description: Measured 1 teaspoon instead of 1/2 teaspoon.
mistakes.visual_cue: The larger 1 tsp measuring spoon is filled with chaat masala.
mistakes.correction: That's the full teaspoon. Use the half-teaspoon spoon for the chaat masala.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand selects the 1 tsp spoon from the set.

mistakes.description: Spilled powder while transferring from the packet to the bowl.
mistakes.visual_cue: Greyish powder dusted on the counter or the rim of the bowl, packet tilted and pouring.
mistakes.correction: Hold the spoon right over the bowl and pour slowly so it doesn't spill, then wipe up the counter.
mistakes.early_cue: Packet tilted steeply while filling the spoon away from the bowl.

mistakes.description: Added chaat masala before whisking the curd.
mistakes.visual_cue: Powder lands on lumpy curd or in an empty bowl.
mistakes.correction: Whisk the curd smooth first, then add the chaat masala.
mistakes.early_cue: Chaat masala packet opened while curd is still unwhisked.
